corporal.linePrev: And I pray our child will never see
stanza: I pray for her who prays for me
A safe return to my belle France
We prayed these wars would end all wars
In war, we know, is no romance
And I pray our child will never see
A little Corporal again
Point toward a foreign shore
Captivate the hearts of men

corporal.line: I've seen a corporal whose nerves were shot
corporal.lineNext: These, these, these are the words
stanza: I've seen and done things I want to forget
These, these, these are the words
The words that maketh murder
I've seen a corporal whose nerves were shot
These, these, these are the words
The words that maketh murder
Climbing behind a fierce, gone sun
These, these, these are the words
The words that maketh murder
I've seen flies swarming everyone
These, these, these are the words
The words that maketh murder
Soldiers fell like lumps of meat
These, these, these are the words
The words that maketh murder
These are the words, the words are these

corporal.lineNext: In proud array standing by the bathing
stanza: Corporal Bradley of Regiment Five
In proud array standing by the bathing
Soldiers and the stevedores
We laid on the mattress and tumbled to sleep
Our eyes aligned, swaddled in our civies
Cradled in our dungarees
